title: Bleach Quiz
tagline: Three difficulties, from Karakura Town to the Royal Realm.
spoiler: Spoiler warning: Medium covers the Arrancar arc. Hard goes all the way through the Thousand-Year Blood War.
controls: 20 seconds per question. Answer fast for more points.
about:
Sixteen questions per difficulty, fifteen drawn at random each run.

**Easy** is Karakura Town and the trip into Soul Society. **Medium** assumes you sat through Hueco Mundo. **Hard** is for people who watched the Thousand-Year Blood War and can still tell their Sternritter apart.

Same engine as the other quizzes: speed and streaks are where the points are.
